shortDescription: Mirror your iPhone, iPad or Mac screen and audio to Fire TV over your local network. Free, open source, with no ads or session time limit.
longDescription:
Your screen. New possibilities.

Bring presentations, photos and other content from your iPhone, iPad or Mac to Fire TV with Buzin Cast, a free, open-source AirPlay receiver. Share screen and audio over your local network, with no subscription, ads or artificial session time limit.

HOW TO CONNECT
1. Connect Fire TV and the sending device to the same local network.
2. Open Buzin Cast on the TV.
3. On your Apple device, open Control Center, choose Screen Mirroring and select Buzin Cast or your customized receiver name.

MAKE IT YOURS
Customize the receiver name, choose the Default, Cinema, Presentation or Games profile and adjust how the image fits your TV. You can also enable connection approval using the TV remote.

EXPERIMENTAL FEATURES
The app includes DLNA and FCast v2 media receiving, local AirPlay mirroring recording and relay between two Buzin Cast receivers. These features have limitations and compatibility depends on the sender and hardware. It is not a certified Google Cast receiver and does not guarantee Chrome mirroring or YouTube/Netflix playback through Cast.

COMPATIBILITY
This release targets Fire TV running Fire OS: the main edition supports Fire OS 6 or later, with a compatibility edition for Fire OS 5. Vega OS is not available yet. Resolution, smoothness and synchronization depend on the source content, network and device decoder.

Buzin Cast receives content you choose; it does not provide a movie catalog, TV channels or subscription services. DRM-protected content may prevent streaming.

reviewInstructions: Requires a Fire TV and an AirPlay-capable iPhone, iPad or Mac on the same local network, with multicast/mDNS allowed. No account, payment or credentials are required. Open the app and note the receiver name. On the Apple device use Control Center > Screen Mirroring > Buzin Cast. Use your own non-DRM content to check picture and audio, stop on the sender and reconnect. Settings support TV remote navigation. DLNA/FCast, recording and relay are experimental and need separate testing; the app is not Google Cast certified. The compatibility APK requires API 22; the main APK requires API 25. No Vega devices in this submission.
